label: Risky: grandchild emergency + secrecy + wire (adapted from M1001 Linda story)

subject: Grandma please don't tell mom, I'm in trouble
body_text: Grandma it's me, my phone is broken so I'm using a friend's email. I got arrested after a car accident and I need bail today. A lawyer, Mr. David Hale, will call you in 20 minutes. label: Legitimate lookalike: real grandchild housing request (M1037 pattern)
subject: Housing deposit, my new account
body_text: Hi Grandpa, thanks for offering to help with the dorm housing deposit. The housing office finally posted the amount, $894, due Friday. My new student account details are in the portal, I'll show you on Sunday when we have lunch and you can pay however you like. Call me anytime.

expected.note: Urgent-ish money ask from a known person, but no secrecy, no blocked verification, invites a call. Must not trigger a push.
